objective: Approve or block the exact enterprise workspace/context contract and isolation design for PR-02 before implementation, including event retirement, stable identities, state ownership, late-response handling, and public-interface test obligations.

inputs.existing_contracts: Frontend-only mock ports AIService, ConversationService, EventService, CompanyService, AnalyticsService; AppContext event functional/company typed non-operational; TanStack Query server-backed state and Zustand/local draft/selection/presentation; module-level mock stores are temporary accepted debt.
acceptance: Explicit workspace switching with stable IDs, never event IDs as workspace IDs.
Late responses/drafts/caches/persisted selection do not cross workspaces.
Event-first target behavior retired unless compatibility explicitly justified.

verification.check: Inspect current contracts/state and return a concrete approved implementation boundary and test contract or blocking findings
verification.expected: Verdict plus exact invariants, allowed contract deltas, state ownership, isolation algorithm, compatibility decision, required public-interface tests, architecture closure criteria

output_schema.verdict: Approved | Approved with conditions | Requires changes
